direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; FactoryStage at least 55vw and 60vh, no page scroll, only inspector and task lists scroll internally
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary #A8F04A on #050705, one per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text, preserving the required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular alignment for quantities, time and cost
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on a real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible focus ring on every interactive element
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo at left and Lock recovery room at right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; StepRail generated from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, never conflating their controls or status; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live=polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Remove the extra logo block above the inspector; retain only the header and opening-story placements at native aspect.
Enlarge JOB-1001 and JOB-1002 quantity and due labels to 13px and move the 40+30=70 units relationship onto the stage summary.
Give Inspector source-evidence rows a 2px neon focus ring and matching SVG highlight on keyboard focus.
Label the pre-flight panel Route health with separate nonce and identity check rows, each with its own status text, distinct from the Investigate task and its Run control.
Add aria-describedby linking the investigation route selector to the offline, no-request explanation.
Increase selector height to 40px and show its focus ring inside the inspector without clipping.
Refit the selected option card so Use verified substitute wraps within its bounds and never overlaps SELECTED, 35h or $3,115.00.
Keep the typed consent form tied to option selection: selecting any feasible path updates the exact APPROVE phrase, plan reference and disabled Accept state together.
Align finish and cost columns on a shared tabular baseline across all three paths in the inspector.
Prevent the MAT-ALLOY-B 70 parts route label from crossing job titles; route it below the label with a clear 40 and 30 split callout.
Show the untracked proposal count once in the inspector header and once in the DecisionBar, removing the repeated dashed notice.
Make Decline proposal a 36px secondary button beside, not below, the scrollable proposal list.
Add PREVIEW - WILL GO OFFLINE text plus dashed silver outline to CELL-MILL-2 before applying, with no red until the stopped state is real.
State the invalidation consequence adjacent to the machine selector and repeat it in the DecisionBar status before Apply second shock.
Enlarge the CELL-MILL-2 selector to 40px with a visible focus ring and pointer style on hover.
Keep stopped CELL-MILL-2 in the reserved red outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED label while removing any feasible route through it.
Retain separate pre-flight nonce and identity health rows above the distinct Reinvestigate recovery evidence task.
Move CONSTRAINED - capacity changed onto its own 11px line so it does not collide with the Split option title.
Refit the constrained Split card so its title, reason and empty metrics align without text touching the selected substitute card above it.
Place the prior acceptance invalidated notice directly above the typed consent form, not only in the DecisionBar.
Ensure the exact APPROVE phrase, typed count and disabled Accept revised decision control update as one labelled group.
Split the inspector into two labelled groups: Prior tracked work - 3 BLOCKED remains visible, and Proposed - untracked until approval for t1 and t2.
Remove the duplicated blocked-versus-proposed summary box to free vertical space for both replacement tasks at 1366x768.
Keep Approve revised tasks as the sole primary while the approved revised plan status stays visible in the DecisionBar centre.
Fix the bottom DecisionBar status to match the inspector tracked count and remove any stale count that conflicts with the sealed event total.
Group Seal encrypted packet, Verify ledger and Export independent checkpoint as three separate 40px controls with independent awaiting and complete states.
Show passphrase length guidance before typing and a text-only strength status after, never relying on colour alone.
Retain the opening-story logo placement count across the full flow and confirm the completion view adds no further logo placement beyond header and opening story.
Make Recovery complete a clear terminal primary with the sealed packet count, revised plan accepted and CELL-MILL-2 offline retained in the DecisionBar status.
Allow the completed evidence summary to be reached by keyboard in inspector order, with focus ring visible against the dark panel.
